children: Panorama Produce is recalling 302 boxes of Martina brand mangoes due to the risk of salmonella.
The Mamaroneck, N.Y., importer said the recalled product was sold at certain Walmart stores in Connecticut, New York, New Jersey and Pennsylvania.
The recalled mangoes, imported from Mexico, have PLU number 4584 and UPC number 07503061948050.

The company said no related illnesses have been reported. It said the recall was initiated after Food and Drug Administration sampling found salmonella in mangoes that weren't distributed into the U.S grown on the same farm.

title: Importer Recalls Mangoes Sold at Certain Walmart Locations Due to Salmonella Risk
